Title: Privacy controls are locally implemented but target policy and worker rollout remain unverified
Impact: A target misconfiguration could allow unauthorized processing or prevent timely privacy-request fulfillment
Mitigation: Require hosted CI staged migration reconciliation approved tenant notice and retention policy live-provider allowlist worker health and backup-expiry runbook before enforcement rollout
ResidualRisk: Medium because legal policy production topology continuous worker operation and backup expiry remain environment-specific

Title: Canonical AI lifecycle is locally implemented but legacy compatibility and target rollout remain unreconciled
Impact: A failed rollout or premature legacy contraction could strand or duplicate jobs and evidence
Mitigation: Keep flags off by default run preflight and postflight reconciliation in staging preserve legacy queue through the compatibility release and require hosted CI
ResidualRisk: Low-Medium until hosted CI staged reconciliation and one compatibility release complete

Title: Budget or compliance block can appear as successful mock result
Impact: Policy bypass misunderstanding and unsafe confirmation
Mitigation: Keep structured-error negative tests required restrict mocks to explicit labeled provider degradation and complete target budget policy verification
ResidualRisk: Low for canonical local privacy routes; target budget-policy ownership and live-provider verification remain open

Title: CI typecheck and dependency advisory regression can recur
Impact: CI failure supply-chain exposure and blocked release
Mitigation: Keep compatible versions pinned run typecheck and vulnerability scans in required CI and review dependency updates
ResidualRisk: Low; hosted CI and periodic dependency monitoring remain required

Title: Global soft-delete filter conflicts with required relationships
Impact: Hidden dependents unexpected query results and restore defects
Mitigation: Audit relationship optionality align filters add model-warning gate and deleted-principal tests
ResidualRisk: Low after model and recovery tests

Title: Redis degradation adds repeated multi-second authenticated latency
Impact: App appears unavailable during cache failure and can exhaust workers
Mitigation: Use fail-fast timeout circuit state bounded fallback health telemetry and fault-injection load test
ResidualRisk: Medium because production topology still needs verification

Title: Backup exists without verified clean restore and release rollback
Impact: Data loss or extended outage when recovery is needed
Mitigation: Create restore runbook isolated drill schema-image compatibility evidence RPO and RTO ownership
ResidualRisk: Medium until scheduled drills are sustained

Title: Canonical links and AI source references are incomplete
Impact: Users lose context cannot share exact state and cannot verify AI claims
Mitigation: Implement entity resolver canonical routes reciprocal links previews and permission-aware source URLs

Title: Oversized pages and services concentrate responsibilities
Impact: Regression slow review merge conflict and unclear ownership
Mitigation: Decompose by use case add architecture tests CODEOWNERS and preserve regression behavior
ResidualRisk: Medium because size alone is not the only coupling measure

Title: Historical readiness claims are not traceable to current evidence
Impact: Incorrect stakeholder decisions and premature production claim
Mitigation: Use dated traceability counts supersede historical report in governance and ban unsupported percentages

Title: GitHub ownership protection and release identity are not locally evidenced
Impact: Unreviewed main changes migration conflict and uncertain rollback artifact
Mitigation: Protected main required reviews CODEOWNERS tags image digest migration owner and release evidence
ResidualRisk: Low-Medium because hosted settings require continuous audit

Title: Advanced assignment and scheduling lack capability and availability data
Mitigation: Add declared skills capacity availability constraints deterministic solver explanations and human confirmation
ResidualRisk: Medium due to data freshness and human planning variability

Title: Settings can report global success after partial server failure
Impact: User believes policy saved when server state differs
Mitigation: Aggregate operation results distinguish device preference from server policy and test partial failure

Title: Optional semantic stack can add dependency work before baseline closure
Impact: Scope diversion startup failures and privacy complexity
Mitigation: Keep semantic disabled by default and defer expansion until P0 AI privacy and cost gates are verified
